summary: A tracker-style sample player that plays waves from the wavetable as in a classic module tracker, with a volume decay, a sample offset for percussion, tuning and effect columns.
use_for: Tracker-style sample playback with tuning and quantised offsets.
quirks: It plays waves from the wavetable: with an empty slot it is silent, so load one with wave_import first (the profile played a test wave).
Volume is squared (amplitude = (raw / 128) squared), so half the range is well under half the loudness.
Sample offset in percussion mode (quantize 1) follows a curve: offset = raw squared / 255; in the piece modes it snaps to the grid.
Tuning is in whole semitones: (raw - 127) / 127 x 5 rounded to the nearest one, five being its default tuning-range attribute; with the attribute at 0 it is a free fine tune instead.
The machine also has two effect columns per note (arpeggio, slides, retriggers and so on) and attributes, none in the parameter list: unverified how notes_write reaches them.
Notes need a Wave in the track; each track plays one sample at a time unless its virtual channels attribute is on.

parameters.name: Ampl.Decay
parameters.how: Sets how fast every note's volume decays, 0 to 254 (0 by default, no decay); the machine raises the volume a little to keep the loudness as it decays.
parameters.sound: A higher value turns sustained samples into plucked or percussive notes.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.how: Sets where in the sample playback starts, 0 to 254 (0 by default, the beginning).
parameters.sound: It lets a loop or break be played from later in the sample, for percussion and slicing.

parameters.name: Quantize
parameters.how: Chooses how the offset is rounded: perc (1) for a free offset on a curve, or 2 to 64 equal pieces (perc by default).
parameters.sound: Pieces snap the start to a grid of slices; perc gives a smooth, finely graded start.

parameters.name: Tuning
parameters.description: Extra tuning in whole semitones, about -5 to +5 around raw 127 (the machine's tuning-range attribute, 5 by default).
parameters.how: Tunes every note in whole semitones, about -5 to +5 around the middle at 127 (the default); the range is the machine's tuning attribute.
parameters.sound: It transposes all notes together; the middle leaves them as written.

track_parameters.name: Wave
track_parameters.how: Chooses the wave from the wavetable that the track plays, 1 to 200 (1 by default).
track_parameters.sound: It is the sample you hear; an empty slot is silent.

track_parameters.name: Volume
track_parameters.how: Sets the volume of the track's notes, 0 to 254 (0 by default), on a squared curve so it feels natural.
track_parameters.sound: Higher values are louder; because of the squared curve the middle of the range is already well below full level.
